## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 jun 2026 - 10 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Anonymous User_, 16 jul 2026, 1/5: "I'm a paid user. I love the app but there are times when it freezes. The freeze happens whenever interacting with habits. I'm experiencing this issue since a very long time. And now I got so frustrated that I'm looking for new habit tracker and cancel the subscription."
            2. _Mardon_, 6 jun 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than a year already. I have recommended the app to many of my friends. But lately it has become so laggy to the degree I don't wanna use it anymore. I don't need fancy any animations. Devs, fix it already please. I'm on Pixel 7 Pro."
            3. _Andraev Reese Artamonov Fernandez_, 21 jul 2026, 3/5: "I love the app, but lately I have been having issues to mark the habits that need multiple points, it does not register and I have to do it multiple times, is really annoying"
